purpose: Check whether the strong baseline's early conventional GPU kernels actually overlap another cell's still-running NeuralRx kernels.
frozen_gate: At least one record with cell1 early conventional while worker0 NRx is host-unobserved, GPU kernel tables in both exports, and at least one intersecting kernel interval within that conventional host-call window. Report zero if absent; do not infer a bound from a positive overlap.
limits: One profiled worker, synthetic P150/D130, profiler overhead and no production DU expiry. Kernel overlap is not a worst-case co-run service guarantee or joint-policy performance comparison.
